key_idea: Direct simulation: check the black count of each row and column equals n/2 and that no three consecutive equal cells exist in any row or column.
sketch: Read the grid. For each row and column count the B cells and compare 2*count to n. For each row and column scan windows of length 3 and reject if all three are equal. Print 1 if all checks pass, else 0. O(n^2). Only pitfall is forgetting the column checks or the bounds on the length-3 window.
